$comment: Trigger evals for the resolver. Each case asserts that a realistic request still reaches the skill that owns it. These are the org chart's regression tests — when a route is edited, these say whether the edit broke someone else's inbox. The no-collision cases below are the other half: requests that CONTAIN a keyword inside an ordinary English word and must not route to it (audit F-47). Every case above was phrased in the vocabulary the keyword lists were written from, so none of them could ever have caught de-ci-sion matching 'ci'.
